tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the default card ground. All body text sits on this or on surface-soft.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Section band, table header and quiet panel ground. Ink, ink-muted and ink-subtle text all pass 4.5:1 here.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Track of bars, skeleton blocks and pressed chip ground. Text on it: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows and around cards. Decoration only, never the sole edge of a form control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, selects, chips and chart axes. 3.5:1 on bg, 3.2:1 on surface-soft, so controls stay visible.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, numbers and body text on bg, surface-soft, surface-sunken and accent (17.3:1 on bg). Also the fill of ShapeLogo tone ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and captions on bg, surface-soft, surface-sunken and estimate-bg (6.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the quietest text on bg and surface-soft (6.1:1 on bg, 5.6:1 on surface-soft). Do not use below 12px.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one action color: primary Button fill, links, focus ring, selected chip border, my-capital marker. White text on it is 6.8:1.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills, link hover, text on brand-soft (7.9:1).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected cards, selected chips, info Notice and the highlight Card. Text on it: brand-strong or ink.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-strong fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm decoration only: ShapeLogo accent tone, cover blocks, hero highlight shapes. Never text on bg (2.5:1); put ink on it (7.0:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. 6.8:1 on bg and 6.3:1 on surface-soft.

tokens.name: estimate-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the estimate Badge and any block that holds an estimated money figure.

tokens.name: estimate-fg
tokens.usage: Text on estimate-bg and bg: the word estimate and its note (8.4:1 on estimate-bg).

tokens.name: estimate-line
tokens.usage: Dashed border of estimate Badge and range figures. Dashed means approximate. 3.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: locked-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the paid (locked) Badge and the lock plate on LockedBlur.

tokens.name: locked-fg
tokens.usage: Text and lock icon on locked-bg (14.4:1).

tokens.name: locked-line
tokens.usage: Border for locked Badge. Same value as locked-bg so the badge reads as one solid shape.

tokens.name: ai-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the AI Badge, AICommentCard header and AI Notice. Used only for premium AI report content.

tokens.name: ai-fg
tokens.usage: Text on ai-bg and bg: the AI label and AI notice text (8.7:1 on ai-bg).

tokens.name: ai-line
tokens.usage: Border of the AI Badge and AI cards (5.0:1 on bg).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of error messages and the danger Notice.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Error text on danger-bg and bg (6.3:1 on danger-bg, 7.2:1 on bg). Always pair with the word error or a plain reason.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of invalid fields and the danger Notice, and the loss part of a RangeBar. 4.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of success and data verified states, and the fit status Badge.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Text on success-bg and bg (7.2:1 on success-bg). Teal, not green, so it stays apart from danger for color-blind readers.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Border of success Badge and the profit part of a RangeBar. 3.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the tight status Badge and the warn Notice.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text on warning-bg and bg (7.9:1 on warning-bg).

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Border of the warning Badge and warn Notice. 3.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the info Notice. Alias of brand-soft.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text on info-bg. Alias of brand-strong.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, darkest (lightness steps keep series apart without hue). Always add a value text, a label and the pattern.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2, same value as brand. Marks need the chart-outline stroke against white.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3, orange. Orange against blue is safe for color vision deficiency.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4, light blue. Always outlined.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5, light sand. Always outlined.

tokens.name: chart-neutral
tokens.usage: Others, unknown and not-comparable parts. Use with the cross-hatch pattern and the word.

tokens.name: chart-outline
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline around chart marks and pattern lines (6.6:1 on bg), so light fills still reach 3:1 against the page.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and the track behind range bars. Decoration.

families.sans: "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans CJK KR", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
families.display: "Figtree", "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page, on bg. 24px or larger, so 3:1 is enough, and ink gives 17:1.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Hero headline on tablet and the premium page headline.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page title below the hero and section titles.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Card group titles and article titles.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles and form section titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Brand card name and component titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a hero and article body.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body text. Minimum for paragraphs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source lines and fine print, only in ink-muted or ink. Never below 12px.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: Hero money range in RangeFigure size lg. Use with tabular-nums.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: Money range in RangeFigure size md and Ledger totals.

styles.name: number-md
styles.usage: Values beside charts and in brand cards.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls, between badge and text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field, small card gutters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding on mobile, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Overlap of the floating SearchBar over the hero.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding before the search card.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart marks and small bars only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, buttons, notices, skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, accordion items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, the SearchBar card, PriceCard.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, ShapeLogo pill, progress track.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting card and input. Always together with a 1px line border.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered card, selected BrandCard, emphasis Card.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Floating SearchBar and the LockedBlur plate. Only for things that sit above the page.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Chip, tab and accordion changes.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Bar growth and gauge markers. All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for every transition.

tokens.name: easing-out
tokens.usage: Things that appear: bars, plates, popovers.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small Button and Chip.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height. Meets the 44px touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of large Button and search submit.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of every page.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Height of SiteHeader on desktop (56px on phones).
